name: Naoyuki
source:
Nami's boyfriend. He’s what you’d call the “cute” type, not at all frivolous, but a polite, well-mannered young man.

He seems to get along well with the protagonist and looks up to him like an older brother. He’s been dating Nami for about a year. His penis is quite large.

His girlfriend, Nami, calls him “Nao.”

[From [url=http://sc-crg.com/katalog/with3/index.html]official site[/url]]
